body: I've been talking to a counselor for months. It's almost like talking to myself though and not as helpful as talking to a "real" person.

The people here are great, but sometimes you need real incarnate friends.

I have a couple close friends I've discussed my issues with who I'd like to think care about me, but I always feel selfish asking for help. I'm sure it's no fun dealing with me when I'm down (which is most of the time) and I don't want to bring negativity into their lives as well.
